name: Digital Logic
short_description: Boolean algebra, combinational circuits, sequential flip-flops, and finite state machines.
description: Binary number systems, Boolean algebra reduction, Karnaugh maps, combinational logic design (adders, multiplexers), and sequential circuits (flip-flops, registers, counters).

courses.title: Digital Logic Fundamentals
courses.description: Binary logic gates, Boolean simplification, and synchronous sequential circuits.

modules.title: Number Systems
modules.description: Binary, octal, hexadecimal representations, and 2's complement arithmetic.

topics.title: Binary Conversions & 2's Complement
topics.summary: Signed binary integer arithmetic and overflow detection.

topics.title: Binary Arithmetic, Overflow & Codes
topics.summary: Signed arithmetic, overflow detection, BCD, Gray code, and parity.

modules.title: Boolean Algebra
modules.description: Postulates, De Morgan's laws, sum-of-products (SOP), and product-of-sums (POS).

topics.title: De Morgan's Laws & Canonical Forms
topics.summary: Boolean identities and minterm/maxterm canonical forms.

modules.title: Logic Gates
modules.description: AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR universal gates, XOR, and propagation delays.

modules.title: K-Maps
modules.description: 2, 3, and 4-variable Karnaugh maps, prime implicants, and don't-care conditions.

topics.title: Karnaugh Map Minimization
topics.summary: Gray code adjacency grouping for minimal SOP expressions.

modules.title: Combinational Circuits
modules.description: Half/full adders, subtractors, multiplexers, demultiplexers, decoders.

topics.title: Adders & Multiplexers Design
topics.summary: Ripple carry adders and MUX-based Boolean logic implementation.

topics.title: Decoders, Encoders & Comparators
topics.summary: Line decoders, priority encoders, and magnitude comparators, and building functions from them.

modules.title: Sequential Circuits
modules.description: Latches, clocking schemes, setup/hold times, and metastability.

topics.title: Latches vs Flip-Flops Timing
topics.summary: Level-sensitive latches vs edge-triggered flip-flop timing diagrams.

modules.title: Flip-Flops
modules.description: SR, JK, D, and T flip-flops, characteristic equations, and excitation tables.

topics.title: JK & D Flip-Flop Operation
topics.summary: Toggle modes, race-around conditions, and master-slave setups.

modules.title: Registers
modules.description: SISO, SIPO, PISO, PIPO shift registers and universal shift registers.

topics.title: Shift Register Architectures
topics.summary: Serial and parallel data conversion registers.

modules.title: Counters
modules.description: Asynchronous ripple counters and synchronous decade/mod-N counters.

topics.title: Synchronous Counter Design
topics.summary: Excitation table synthesis for modulo-N sequence counters.

modules.title: Finite State Machines
modules.description: Designing sequential controllers from state diagrams.

topics.title: Mealy & Moore State Machine Design
topics.summary: State diagrams, state tables, state assignment, and implementation with flip-flops.
